review_description: These people were as dodgy as they come, more fool us. They took months and months and months to finalise our order; they debited our credit card for the full amount before the installation was completed; the inverter took another 6 weeks to be installed and we had to chase them up; the inverter (a cheap Chinese model) completely burned out after only a year of operating; the company (Solar Domain) had gone out of business by then so we had no redress and were out of pocket to install a better quality German model inverter.
